    // The two endpoints ordered A.Value <= B.Value, matching the canonical form
    // `UndirectedEdgeList` (`topology.types.plato`) stores.
    CanonicalPair(a: VertexIndex, b: VertexIndex): VertexPair
        => a.Value <= b.Value ? VertexPair(a, b) : VertexPair(b, a);
